build_table_schema_dataframe: build a table schema from a DataFrame with integer, string, datetime, and duration columns
build_table_schema_series: build a table schema from a Series with a named index and integer values
convert_pandas_type_to_json_field: convert a pandas Series or Index to a JSON field dict with type, name, and optional constraints
convert_json_field_to_pandas_type: convert a JSON field dict to the corresponding pandas dtype including categorical with enum constraints
test_json_table_orient_roundtrip: test roundtrip serialization of a DataFrame with orient table to JSON and back via read_json
